# Best waterproof Bluetooth speakers for the pool or beach

**My top pick: JBL Charge 6 (about $130-150).** It has an IP68 rating (dust-tight, survives submersion), 20 hours of battery (28 with Playtime Boost), and it can charge your phone. What Hi-Fi named it best overall, and BestProducts did too. Prices were $129.99 at Walmart and $149.95 at Amazon in What Hi-Fi's listing. [What Hi-Fi picks and buy links](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart) · [BestProducts review](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)

## Other good options

| Need | Pick | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Loudest for pool parties | **JBL Boombox 4** | RTINGS' top waterproof pick. It floats, survives long immersion, and gets 40+ hours of battery. Its sound is narrow, so it's best when you're in front of it. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth) |
| 360° sound while you swim around it | **Ultimate Ears Epicboom** | Tom's Guide's best overall (IP67) and RTINGS' best mid-range. It floats and has about 15 hours of battery. [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers) |
| Budget | **Ultimate Ears Wonderboom 4** (~$65-80) | IP67, floats, about 14 hours, and the 360° sound is big for its size. [BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/) |
| Cheapest and pocket-sized | **JBL Go 5** (~$40) | IP67, but only about 8 hours of battery. [What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart) |
| Easy to carry | **JBL Grip** (~$100) | IP68, under a pound, and loud enough for a crowd. The mesh body can collect dust. [Good Housekeeping](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/) |
| Floating party speaker | **Soundcore Boom 2** (~$110) | It floats and has punchy bass and lights. It has no dust rating, so keep it on a towel, not in sand. [BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/) |

**Bigger Soundcore option:** the Boom 2 Plus is a 100 W, IPX7 floating speaker that weighs 3.8 kg (about 8.4 lb). It lists at $249.99, and Dealectric reports code AFSC20 takes $49.99 off at Soundcore's store, for about $200. The code worked when Dealectric tested it on Oct 22, but checkout has the final word. [Buy at Soundcore](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-2-plus) (affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you).

## Beach and pool tips
- **Look for IP67 or higher.** Good Housekeeping recommends at least IPX7. Add a dust rating (IP6X) if you'll be on sand.
- **Waterproof isn't salt- or chlorine-proof.** IP ratings don't cover corrosion, so rinse the speaker with fresh water if the manual allows it. Let it dry fully before charging. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)
- **Close the charging-port flap** before it gets wet, and keep the speaker out of direct sun and off the sand.

Apart from the Soundcore link, I only have review pages that list retailers like Amazon, Walmart, and Best Buy, not direct product links. Prices change, so check them at checkout.
